about: This Girl Explaining template is actually the side-by-side often called Me Explaining to My Mom. On the left a young woman in a headwrap and white T-shirt gestures with both hands, eyes watery and earnest, clearly deep into an emotional explanation. On the right an older woman sits on a couch wrapped in a Dallas Cowboys blanket, staring back with a completely blank, unconvinced expression. The joke is the wall between a passionate explainer and a listener who has no idea what they are talking about and is not trying to find out.
usage:
The left box is the explainer and what they are passionately explaining, usually "me explaining" plus a niche topic. The right box is the listener: mom, a friend, a manager, the group chat.

It works best when the topic is obscure, lore-heavy or very online and the listener is someone who could not care less. Anime plots, why a game nerf matters, crypto, fantasy football trades, why the meme is funny. Short labels on the right let the blank stare carry the punchline.
ideas: me explaining why the meme is funny
me explaining the entire one piece lore
me explaining why this nerf ruins the meta
me explaining why the deploy failed
me explaining why I need a fourth monitor
